business_overview.one_sentence: BOE Varitronix designs, manufactures and sells LCD and related display products, mainly automotive and industrial display modules.

segments.name: Automotive and industrial display business
segments.description: TFT products, touch panel display modules and automotive system products, including instrument clusters, center displays, HUD and e-mirror displays.

business_overview.revenue_model: Revenue is recognized at a point in time when control over goods is transferred to customers; revenue represents invoiced value of goods supplied less returns and discounts.
business_notes: The Company is an investment holding company; group operations are display design, manufacturing and sales.
One customer contributed approximately HKD 3,176.791m of 2025 revenue, exceeding 10% of group revenue.
The group has manufacturing and assembly capacity in monochrome display, TFT and touch panel display modules.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Income from funds assets, not core manufacturing profit.

non_recurring_items.item: Changes in fair value of other financial assets
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Fair-value gain from financial assets included in cash-flow reconciliation.
Government grant income amortised to profit, not customer manufacturing cash profit.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Three-year operating cash flow covers reported profit, but 2025 profit declined and capital expenditure remains material. The annual report does not split maintenance and growth capex, so owner-earnback analysis uses a discounted distributable cash profit.

evidence.business_substance: Sales of LCD and related display products.
evidence.source: Annual Report 2025 consolidated statement of profit or loss, page 142

evidence.business_substance: Cash and cash equivalents plus fixed deposits over three months.
Funds situated in Chinese Mainland; remittance out is subject to relevant foreign exchange rules and regulations.
2025 operating cash flow less PPE and intangible purchases.
evidence.source: Annual Report 2025 consolidated cash flow statement, page 147

gaps: Parent-only cash and deposits were not disclosed in extracted annual report text.
Maintenance capital expenditure was not separately disclosed from total PPE and intangible purchases.
Detailed restriction conditions for 2025 restricted bank deposits were not disclosed beyond restricted under conditions.

Gross profit is not presented directly in the consolidated profit or loss statement; cost of inventories is available in note 6(b), but total gross profit by management segment was not separately extracted.
